cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the concert chairs where they are. We promised to bring this village together, and we're starting on time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The power's out. Nobody will hear the microphones.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then move the singers in among the chairs. I'll give the first note; everyone can join without a microphone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Half the audience has gone home to fetch torches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave their places ready and start with the people here. When they come back, bring them down the middle with the lights. They've found another way to join in.

reason: Make B torch-fetching solution become a planned collective entrance; A directs present singers and returning audience without pretending light has already arrived.
